appeal.title: Help Build a Lasting Legacy
appeal.shortDescription: The Masjid has always been a beacon of faith, community, and service. Now, as we embark on a transformative journey to redevelop and enhance this sacred space, we invite you to be a part of something truly special.

children.text: As our community continues to grow, the need for a larger and more accommodating space has become essential. Your support will help expand prayer areas, ensuring that everyone has a place to worship comfortably. It will also enhance educational facilities for both children and adults, fostering knowledge and spiritual growth. Additionally, improving accessibility will make it easier for the elderly and disabled to participate in prayers and community activities.

appeals.title: Ramadan Appeal – Jamia Masjid & Madrasah Mehmoodia
appeals.shortDescription: Support Jamia Masjid & Madrasah Mehmoodia this Ramadan. Your donations help sustain Qur’anic teaching and community services. Donate after Dhur, Asr & Maghrib at Masjid Al-Falah.

children.text: Collecting After Dhur, Asr & Maghrib at Masjid Al-Falah

Jamia Masjid & Madrasah Mehmoodia is a community mosque and Islamic educational centre dedicated to providing foundational Islamic teaching alongside regular worship services. As with many mosque-associated madaris, its purpose is to offer Qur’anic instruction, basic Islamic studies and religious guidance to children and adults alike, fostering spiritual growth and community cohesion.

Mosques with associated madrasah programmes play a vital role in developing young learners’ understanding of the Qur’an, Islamic ethics and moral character, especially where formal educational access may be limited. Through daily prayers, Qur’anic lessons, and teacher-guided instruction, institutions like Jamia Masjid & Madrasah Mehmoodia nurture religious knowledge and community values.

This Ramadan, Masjid Al-Falah welcomes Jamia Masjid & Madrasah Mehmoodia as part of our approved Ramadan charity schedule. Your donations help sustain its educational activities, community services and the continuation of worship and study.
Jamia Masjid & Madrasah Mehmoodia will be collecting:
Masjid Al-Falah, North Ilford Islamic Centre

Sawarana Jumma Mosque is a community mosque located in the town of Sawarana in Chilaw, Sri Lanka. Serving as an active centre for daily prayers and Islamic gatherings, this mosque is rooted in the tradition of weekly Jumma (Friday) prayers that bring families and neighbours together for worship and spiritual reflection.

Mosques like Sawarana Jumma often act as community pillars — beyond being spaces for prayer, they host Islamic education sessions, Qur’anic learning circles, and social support activities that strengthen the local Muslim community.

This Ramadan, Masjid Al-Falah welcomes Sawarana Jumma Mosque as part of our approved Ramadan charity schedule. Your donations at the collection point help support the mosque’s community services, local religious programmes and its continued role as a place of worship and learning.

appeals.title: Ramadan Appeal – Jamiah Mazhar-e-Sa’adat Hansot
appeals.shortDescription: Support Jamiah Mazhar-e-Sa’adat Hansot this Ramadan. Your donations help nurture over 1,000 students through Qur’anic and Islamic education. Donate after Dhur, Asr & Maghrib at Masjid Al-Falah.

children.text: Collecting After Dhur, Asr & Maghrib at Masjid Al-Falah

Jamiah Mazhar-e-Sa’adat Hansot is a respected Islamic educational institution located in the Baruch district of South Gujarat. Established in 1985 under the guidance of Hazrat Mufti Abdullah Mazahiri Sahib (RA), the Jamiah began with only a handful of students and dedicated teachers. Through sincerity, sacrifice and community support, it has grown into one of the most recognised Islamic institutions in the region, now nurturing over 1,000 students.

For more than four decades, the Jamiah has remained committed to providing structured Islamic education rooted in the teachings of the Qur’an and Hadith. Its mission is not only to impart knowledge but to cultivate religious consciousness, strong character and ethical responsibility. Many of its students come from areas where access to quality Islamic and secular education is limited, making the institution a vital centre of learning and opportunity.

The Jamiah integrates religious scholarship with broader academic and personal development. It promotes intellectual, social, emotional and spiritual growth within a safe and disciplined learning environment. The curriculum aims to prepare students to become practicing scholars and responsible members of society — individuals who embody Islamic values while contributing positively to their communities.

The vision of its founder was to nurture a small seed of religious education into a flourishing institution with a distinct identity. Today, Jamiah Mazhar-e-Sa’adat is widely respected for its dedication to excellence in teaching and its service to Islamic scholarship across Gujarat and beyond.

This Ramadan, Masjid Al-Falah welcomes Jamiah Mazhar-e-Sa’adat Hansot as part of our approved Ramadan charity schedule. Your donations help sustain student education, faculty support, boarding facilities and the continued propagation of Islamic sciences.

Masjid Al-Falah facilitates Ramadan collections for approved institutions under a structured calendar system. The Masjid does not administer external organisations, and donors are encouraged to exercise personal due diligence before contributing. appeals.title: Ramadan Appeal – Darul Uloom Deoband
appeals.shortDescription: Support Darul Uloom Deoband on Ramadan Day 12 at Masjid Al-Falah. Donate after Dhur, Asr & Maghrib to help sustain over 150 years of Islamic scholarship.

children.text: Collecting After Dhur, Asr & Maghrib at Masjid Al-Falah

Darul Uloom Deoband is one of the most historic and influential Islamic seminaries in the world. Established in 1866 in Deoband, Uttar Pradesh, India, the institution was founded with the mission of preserving Islamic scholarship during a period of political and social upheaval.

From its humble beginnings in a small mosque classroom, Darul Uloom Deoband grew into a globally recognised centre of Islamic learning. For over 150 years, it has played a central role in the preservation and transmission of classical Islamic sciences.
Arabic language and classical Islamic sciences

Its curriculum follows the traditional Dars-e-Nizami syllabus and has influenced Islamic institutions worldwide. Thousands of graduates have gone on to serve communities across Asia, Africa, Europe and beyond.
Darul Uloom Deoband is widely recognised for its commitment to academic rigor, disciplined scholarship and adherence to the Qur’an and Sunnah.

This Ramadan, Masjid Al-Falah welcomes Darul Uloom Deoband as part of our approved Ramadan charity schedule. Your donations help sustain students, faculty, boarding facilities and the continued preservation of classical Islamic knowledge.
Darul Uloom Deoband will be collecting:
Masjid Al-Falah, North Ilford Islamic Centre
By supporting this appeal, you contribute to sustaining over 150 years of Islamic education and the training of future scholars who continue to serve communities around the world.

appeals.title: Ahlia Darul Uloom Moinul Islam (Darul Uloom Hathazari), Bangladesh
appeals.shortDescription: Support Ahlia Darul Uloom Moinul Islam this Ramadan. Your donations help sustain traditional Islamic education and student welfare in Bangladesh. Donate after Dhur, Asr & Maghrib at Masjid Al-Falah.

whyMatters.sectionTitle: Ahlia Darul Uloom Moinul Islam (Hathazari, Bangladesh)

children.text: Collecting After Dhur, Asr & Maghrib at Masjid Al-Falah
Ahlia Darul Uloom Moinul Islam — popularly known as

— is among the oldest and largest Islamic educational institutions in Bangladesh. Located in Hathazari, in the Chittagong District of Bangladesh, this historic Qawmi seminary was established in 1901 and has since become a central hub of traditional Islamic scholarship in the country.

For over a century, the institution has been dedicated to providing deep religious education grounded in the Qur’an, Hadith, Fiqh (Islamic jurisprudence) and classical Arabic sciences, following the Deobandi tradition. It is well known for its broad curriculum spanning basic religious instruction to advanced Hadith and Fiqh studies, and continues to serve thousands of students under the guidance of highly qualified scholars and teachers.

Darul Uloom Moinul Islam has played a vital role in the spread of Islamic knowledge throughout Bangladesh and the wider region. Its graduates have gone on to serve communities as teachers, imams, jurists and religious leaders, embodying the seminary’s mission to preserve and propagate authentic Islamic learning.

children.text: Collecting After Dhur, Asr & Maghrib at Masjid Al-Falah

Darul Uloom Tanda is an Islamic educational institution located in the Tanda Badli area of Rampur district, Uttar Pradesh, India. Like other traditional Darul Ulooms across the Indian subcontinent, it serves as a centre for Qur’anic education, memorisation (Hifz), Arabic language instruction and foundational Islamic studies based on classical curricula.

These seminaries play a vital role in their communities by nurturing students in religious knowledge, moral discipline and spiritual development. For many students, Darul Uloom Tanda offers structured Islamic learning that might otherwise be unavailable in their local context.

This Ramadan, Masjid Al-Falah welcomes Darul Uloom Tanda as part of our approved Ramadan charity schedule. Your donations help sustain the institution’s educational activities, support teaching staff and provide access to religious education for students who might otherwise lack such opportunities.
